description:
Leidos is in need of a software applications developer to support a dynamic and exciting software development program. This position will be part of a team of application developers supporting multiple projects, which include high profile high visibility projects offering technical learning opportunities. Most of our projects are all within the cloud and support multiple mission partners. The ideal candidate will have AWS experience developing for the cloud to include complete secure cloud integrations, optimizing cloud connectivity, and managed cloud services. The selected candidate will be joining a team working on a high priority Salesforce project and expected to come up to speed as quickly as possible. 

 Primary Responsibilities: 
 The ideal software developer will have the capacity to develop web applications using Java, JavaScript, NodeJS, and/or Angular. 
 ServiceNow and Salesforce skills are desirable skill sets to support emerging technology. 
 The developer will work with the overall program team in the design and development of new applications as well as integrating new solutions on existing applications.  
 The candidate will be able to analyze and solve complex application development needs to identify solutions to include potential new tools/technologies.  
 A strong candidate will have commanding knowledge of JavaScript software development principles and be energized by the capability to learn and implement new skills. 
 The candidate should be proficient in web application development to include troubleshooting and software upgrades. 
 Products and/or services reside in development, test and production AWS environments. 
 Experience working in a DevOps environment developing within an Agile environment using code delivery mechanisms, such as Maven, Ant, continuous build systems such as Jenkins, Nitro, Git, and code repositories such as Subversion.
 
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Requires a Bachelor and a minimum of 12 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with minimum of 10 years of prior relevant experience
 Clearance: Must have an active TS/SCI with Polygraph to be considered
 Highly desired for candidates to have Salesforce Development – Platform experience or a willingness to learn/get training on Salesforce quickly. 
 Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and front-end frameworks including Angular, Vue, and React
 Experience with Python, Java and/or Node
 Experience with Rest API development
 Experience with Serverless Application Development
 Working knowledge of AWS services, specifically: RDS (MySQL), DynamoDB, Lambda, and Open Search
 Working knowledge of Automation Tools, specifically: Cloud Formation, Jenkins, and CDK
 Comfortable operating in a Linux development environment
 Comfortable utilizing VSCode
 Excited about tackling unfamiliar tech stacks and adapting quickly to new tools and challenges
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Salesforce Development – Platform
 Apex experience
 Lighting web components
 Process automation
 ServiceNow Development/Administration
 Docker Container experience
 Experience developing in PHP or the willingness to learn PHP
 Experience developing HTML views with CSS
 
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
October 8, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $131,300.00 - $237,350.00 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
